def beam(frame):
    lines=frame.ascii.splitlines(); cols=[];rows=[]

    return (min(cols),max(cols),min(rows),max(rows)) if cols else None
def mblock(frame,col):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:

    return None

print('AFTER beam',beam(current_frame),'R',mblock(current_frame,'R'),'step',current_frame.step)

</function>
